Project overview

  • Role: Lead Product Designer & Front-end Developer
  • Company: Medicspot (telemedicine & pharmacy clinic network)
  • Timeline: July 2021 – July 2022
  • Team: Cross-functional team alongside Marketing, Medical Operations, and Core Engineering
  • Core skills demonstrated: User research and UX auditing, UI system design (Figma), front-end engineering (React, TypeScript, Next.js), Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO), on-page technical SEO, and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA)

What this project proves about me: I bridge the gap between design architecture and production code, translating complex clinical user journeys into high-converting, accessible digital healthcare products.

The multi-device responsive redesign for Medicspot desktop and mobile, prioritising clear information hierarchy, clinical trust signals, and rapid booking pathways.

The challenge

Medicspot operates in a high-stakes, time-sensitive environment where users are often anxious, unwell, or navigating strict international travel requirements for Covid-19 testing. The existing digital touchpoints faced several critical friction points:

  1. Fragmented user journeys: Navigation across urgent clinical appointments, recurring memberships, and testing kits was fragmented, resulting in high drop-off rates on mobile.
  2. Funnel abandonment: The multi-step booking and basket checkout flows suffered from visual clutter, poor form accessibility, and hidden transaction costs.
  3. Scalability and technical debt: The front end required modern, modular engineering (React/TypeScript) with rigorous on-page technical Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) compliance to maintain organic search dominance and support patients with varied accessibility needs.

My process

  1. Discovery & Quantitative Auditing: Evaluated behavioural analytics using Google Analytics, session heatmaps, and funnel drop-off reports to isolate checkout and booking pain points.
  2. Information Architecture & Wireframing: Restructured global navigation, mobile drawer patterns, and clinic locator pathways using low-fidelity wireframes in Figma.
  3. Iterative UI Prototyping: Explored multiple visual hierarchies, hero configurations, and trust-building patterns before creating high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
  4. Production Engineering: Built and deployed reusable frontend components using React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Material UI, enforcing clean semantic HTML5 and ARIA markup.
  5. CRO & Experimentation: Applied A/B testing and basket optimisations alongside the marketing team to systematically validate copy, hierarchy, and form simplicity.

What I did

Information architecture and mobile navigation

Mobile users accounted for the majority of urgent bookings. I restructured the global navigation drawer to categorise services cleanly into virtual appointments, in-person pharmacy clinics, travel testing, and recurring memberships.

Exploration of mobile navigation drawer variations, evaluating layout densities, expandable accordion structures, and clear colour-coded categorisation.

Homepage redesign and trust architecture

The primary homepage needed to present complex telemedicine offerings without overwhelming patients in need of immediate clinical care. I designed modular, scannable layouts supported by prominent trust accreditations (CQC verification, Trustpilot reviews) and clear dual CTAs.

Iterative homepage layout exploration assessing alternative hero arrangements, social proof placements, and primary task drivers.

The finalised desktop landing page UI, balancing clean visual hierarchy, explanatory media, and straightforward clinical service cards.

Direct comparison showing the transition from an outdated, text-heavy layout to an open, modern, and accessible design system.

Upselling memberships within booking flows

To increase customer lifetime value, I introduced context-sensitive membership upsells directly into the appointment booking flow, demonstrating cost savings at the precise moment of purchase intent.

Contextual membership prompt integrated seamlessly into the telephone consultation booking journey.

Dynamic savings comparison embedded within the in-person local pharmacy clinic booking step.

Clinic finder UX

I redesigned the interactive clinic finder to provide instant postcode-based filtering, live appointment availability, and transparent pricing. View the Clinic Finder UX in Figma.

Packaging iconography and travel hub pages

Clear communication was vital during the pandemic. I created custom iconography for physical Covid test packaging to clarify self-swab instructions and minimise user error.

Custom iconography suite designed for Covid-19 physical packaging and digital instructional collateral.

To support dynamic travel restrictions, I engineered tailored country landing pages to reassure travellers and clarify testing timelines.

Header and landing page concepts created for dynamic country-specific travel testing hubs.

The complete production country landing page, integrating real-time travel guidelines, product requirements, and rapid checkout links.

Funnel and basket conversion optimisation

Analytics revealed significant drop-offs at the basket review stage. I redesigned the checkout drawer to remove extraneous links, highlight delivery timelines, and explicitly state what was included.

Before:

The original basket interface showing visual clutter, weak visual hierarchy, and unclear order breakdowns.

After:

The optimised basket drawer featuring clean line-item summaries, trust guarantees, and an unmistakable primary CTA.

Booking form simplification

I redesigned the complex clinical intake questionnaire into a single-column, progressive disclosure flow with clear validation states.

Complete multi-step patient booking and payment interface flow, engineered for high completion rates and cognitive ease.

Why I made these decisions

  1. Progressive disclosure over single-page forms: Clinical triage requires gathering substantial medical history. Presenting all inputs at once increased cognitive overload and abandonment. Breaking the booking into logical, digestible steps lowered bounce rates.
  2. In-funnel membership upselling: Rather than relying purely on dedicated membership landing pages, introducing transparent comparison modals during local booking targeted users when the direct value proposition (immediate savings on this visit) was strongest.
  3. Componentised design tokens in React: Building the UI using Material UI and custom CSS variables ensured brand alignment across marketing campaigns and product flows while reducing code bloat and accelerating page performance.
  4. Accessibility-first interaction design: Clinical services require strict compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. I ensured sufficient colour contrast, full keyboard navigation, and explicit ARIA labels on all dynamic forms.

Impact / results

Area Initiative Documented Outcome
Search Visibility On-page technical SEO & Schema markup Achieved 1st position ranking for key commercial and clinical search terms
Conversion Funnels Basket & checkout CRO redesign Reduced checkout friction, eliminated hidden fees, and improved purchase completion rates
Revenue Diversification Contextual booking upselling Successfully drove recurring membership sign-ups through existing appointment traffic
Platform Performance Code minification, lazy loading, React refactor Drastically reduced page load times, improving Core Web Vitals and mobile engagement
Accessibility Semantic HTML5 & WCAG 2.1 AA implementation Ensured fully compliant screen reader navigation across booking and intake flows

Roles performed on this project

  • Product Designer: Led user journey mapping, design explorations, responsive wireframes, and production Figma prototypes.
  • Front-end Developer: Authored clean, performant, and accessible front-end code using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
  • CRO Specialist: Audited conversion funnels, redesigned key checkout steps, and executed testing iterations to minimise abandonment.
  • Technical SEO Contributor: Implemented structured metadata, schema markup, and performance optimisations to secure search engine authority.

childMarkdownRemark.html: During a critical phase of rapid growth and shifting healthcare demands, Medicspot required an accessible, high-converting digital platform across its core telemedicine services and Covid-19 testing operations. Serving as both Lead Product Designer and Front-end Developer, I audited user journeys, resolved complex booking funnels, and engineered responsive interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Material UI. Through close collaboration with marketing and engineering, I delivered comprehensive homepage redesigns, streamlined clinic search flows, introduced upsell funnels, and optimised the checkout basket for conversion rate optimisation (CRO). The resulting platform achieved top search visibility, improved key funnel completion rates, and established a compliant, WCAG-aligned design system across mobile and desktop touchpoints.
